setup: CREATE TABLE dw (id INTEGER, k DECIMAL(6,2), p INTEGER)

cases.name: rounded_order_peers
cases.sql: SELECT id,RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p ORDER BY CAST(k AS DECIMAL(5,1)) NULLS LAST) AS r,DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p ORDER BY CAST(k AS DECIMAL(5,1)) NULLS LAST) AS d FROM dw ORDER BY id
cases.derivation: p1 rounded keys in order: -1.3,1.2,1.3,1.3,NULL. p2 has one row.

cases.name: rounded_partition_coalesces
cases.sql: SELECT id,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY k::NUMERIC(5,1) ORDER BY id) AS n FROM dw ORDER BY id
cases.derivation: ids2,3,6 share rounded key1.3; other keys each have one row.

cases.name: grouped_sum_cast_key
cases.sql: SELECT p,RANK() OVER (ORDER BY CAST(SUM(k) AS DEC(5,1))) AS r FROM dw GROUP BY p ORDER BY p
cases.derivation: p1 sum2.50 rounds2.5; p2 sum1.25 rounds1.3.

cases.name: cast_window_output
cases.sql: SELECT id,CAST(ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p ORDER BY id) AS DECIMAL(3,1)) AS n FROM dw ORDER BY id
cases.derivation: Exact rank integers convert to coefficients10,20,30,40,50,10.

cases.name: alias_cast_before_window
cases.sql: SELECT id,RANK() OVER (ORDER BY rounded NULLS LAST) AS r FROM (SELECT id,CAST(k AS DECIMAL(5,1)) AS rounded FROM dw) q ORDER BY id
cases.derivation: Global rounded order puts id4 first,id1 second,ids2,3,6 tied third,NULL sixth.

cases.name: filtered_key_overflow_absent
cases.sql: SELECT id,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY CAST(id + 5 AS DECIMAL(1,0))) AS n FROM dw WHERE id <= 4 ORDER BY id
cases.derivation: WHERE removes ids5,6 before keys are evaluated; remaining keys6..9 fit.

cases.name: limit_does_not_hide_key_overflow
cases.sql: SELECT id,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY CAST(id + 5 AS DECIMAL(1,0))) AS n FROM dw ORDER BY id LIMIT 1
cases.derivation: Window keys for id5 and6 overflow before final LIMIT.

cases.name: case_key_masks_overflow
cases.sql: SELECT id,RANK() OVER (ORDER BY CASE WHEN id <= 4 THEN CAST(id + 5 AS DECIMAL(1,0)) ELSE CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(1,0)) END) AS r FROM dw ORDER BY id
cases.derivation: CASE masks unsafe casts on ids5,6; zero keys tie first,keys6..9 rank3..6.

cases.name: case_window_output_masks_overflow
cases.sql: SELECT id,CASE WHEN id <= 4 THEN CAST(ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY id) + 5 AS DECIMAL(1,0)) ELSE CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(1,0)) END AS n FROM dw ORDER BY id
cases.derivation: Window numbers1..6 are computed; CASE reaches the cast only for numbers1..4.

cases.name: reached_window_output_overflow
cases.sql: SELECT id,CAST(ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY id) + 5 AS DECIMAL(1,0)) AS n FROM dw ORDER BY id
cases.derivation: The reached projection casts10 and11 and must fail.

cases.name: same_scale_key_narrowing
cases.sql: SELECT id,RANK() OVER (ORDER BY CAST(CAST(id + 5 AS DECIMAL(3,0)) AS DECIMAL(1,0))) AS r FROM dw ORDER BY id
cases.derivation: Outer same-scale precision narrowing must check10 and11.

cases.name: null_and_nested_cast_keys
cases.sql: SELECT id,DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p ORDER BY CAST(CAST(k AS DECIMAL(5,1)) AS NUMERIC(6,2)) NULLS FIRST) AS r FROM dw ORDER BY id
cases.derivation: p1 distinct keys with NULL first are NULL,-1.30,1.20,1.30; p2 singleton rank1.
